name: Gaussian Frosting
definition: A mesh-based representation for high-quality rendering and editing of complex 3D effects in real-time. It augments a base mesh with an adaptive layer of 3D Gaussians (the 'Frosting') with variable thickness to capture fine details and volumetric effects near the surface, such as hair or grass.
summary: Gaussian Frosting augments triangle meshes with an adaptive 3D Gaussian layer to capture fine volumetric details like hair while preserving mesh editability and rendering quality.
